notes.title: The Card Man Has Arrived!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663402/7e75baef8e4b3cb786addb32dd262663f25b69d9.gif"][/img][/p][p]His Sleight of Hand allows him to teleport to a card he has thrown in the direction of a pesky criminal[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663402/6cbcb9b3c19117b0100db6527ad10edfafd5579a.gif"][/img][/p][p]But for reasons beyond any robber's knowledge, he gives you a chance. Pick the right card, he let's you escape. Pick the wrong one, and head straight to jail.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663402/56c8489d04b9eff96711b3063ba7fccc1640604e.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Play Demo Now!
notes.content: [p]Crime City's banks are there for the taking! [/p][p]Grab your friends and check out Robbing Time's introduction map and the first map: Crime City Central Bank.[/p][p]Use the loot to customize your character in the skin shop or unlock the first 3 items available in the demo:[/p][list][*][p]The Enemy Detector[/p][/*][*][p]The Energy Drink[/p][/*][*][p]and the iconic Crowbar[/p][/*][/list][p]Now go and rob that bank![/p]

notes.title: Robbing Time Demo Date Announced
notes.content: [h1]Robbing Time Demo Announced[/h1][p][/p][p]We are very excited to announce that our demo will be released on 14th of July. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821300/Robbing_Time_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You will be able to play the demo solo or with a team of up to 5 people. The demo will allow you to tackle the first level (Crime City Central Bank) of the game in 2 modes: The Introduction and the Main Mode.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663402/3b11850351cf4fe55f033b565970d88513fc94bd.png"][/img][/p][p]The introduction is an easier and smaller version of the map, where you can learn the ropes of Robbing Time and how to rob the bank. After that, prove your worth in Main Mode, where the objective will be harder and the Superhero will be right on your tail from the start![/p]
